components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sentence-case cadmium chip; label is button-text, never --white.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.3rem; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.7rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--primary, #e24e1b); color: #ffffff; font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 620; font-variation-settings: "CASL" 0, "CRSV" 0, "MONO" 0; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark, #b33a12); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06), 0 4px 12px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.08); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Panel fill, ink label, sentence-case chip.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.3rem; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.7rem; border: 1px solid var(--grey-200, #d6d0c6); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--white, #fffcf7); color: var(--grey-900, #1c1917); font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 620; font-variation-settings: "CASL" 0; text-transform: none; line-height: 1; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06), 0 4px 12px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tertiary Button
components.description: No fill; linen wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-tertiary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.7rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #1c1917); font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 620; font-variation-settings: "CASL" 0; text-transform: none; line-height: 1; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-tertiary:hover { background: var(--grey-100, #f4f1ea); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Cream field, 1px stone hairline; cadmium border on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--grey-200, #d6d0c6); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--white, #fffcf7); color: var(--text-strong, #1c1917); font-family: Recursive, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-variation-settings: "CASL" 0; line-height: 1.45; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--grey-300, #bcb4a9); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #e24e1b); box-shadow: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsla(15.4deg, 78.6%, 49.6%, 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Border-plus-lift: 1px hairline, no shadow at rest.
components.html:
Project
Next actions stay on the linen.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--white, #fffcf7); color: var(--text, #1c1917); border: 1px solid var(--card-border-color, #d6d0c6); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: none; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06), 0 4px 12px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06); } .ds-card-header { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text-strong, #1c1917); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-border-color, #d6d0c6); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; font-family: Recursive, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Dark-rail row; idle cream-muted, active fills #2a2522.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0.38rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--rail-muted, #c4bdb4); font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-variation-settings: "CASL" 0; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #2a2522; color: var(--rail-ink, #f5f0e8); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; margin-inline-end: 0.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #2a2522; color: var(--rail-ink, #f5f0e8); } .ds-nav-item-active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--primary, #e24e1b); }

components.name: Label Chip
components.description: Task label; color is the label hex, not cadmium.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--grey-200, #d6d0c6); color: var(--grey-900, #1c1917); font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 450; font-variation-settings: "CASL" 0; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kanban Card
components.description: Hairline ticket; cadmium title; sage strike when done. Phone tap expands in place.
components.css: .ds-kanban { display: block; background: var(--white, #fffcf7); border: 1px solid var(--card-border-color, #d6d0c6); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: none; padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-kanban:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06), 0 4px 12px hsla(20, 14%, 10%, 0.06); border-color: var(--grey-300, #bcb4a9); } .ds-kanban:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kanban-title { margin: 0; font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary, #e24e1b); overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; } .ds-kanban-pip { display: inline-block; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border-radius: 100%; background: var(--primary, #e24e1b); }

components.name: Kanban Phone Pager
components.description: One named bucket at a time; cadmium title; 44px prev/next; snap off when reduced-motion.
components.html: Doing
components.css: .ds-pager { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: 0.5rem; background: var(--grey-100, #f4f1ea); border: 1px solid var(--card-border-color, #d6d0c6); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-pager-title { flex: 1 1 auto; margin: 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; text-align: center; font-family: Recursive, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--primary, #e24e1b); } .ds-pager-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--grey-500, #8e857b); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pager-nav svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; } .ds-pager-nav:hover:not(:disabled), .ds-pager-nav:focus-visible { color: var(--primary, #e24e1b); } .ds-pager-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #e24e1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pager-nav:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }

narrative.overview:
A three-column operator: dark project rail, linen work surface, cream task inspector that appears only while a task is open. Cadmium is the one hot tool — primary actions, focus, “you are here,” and the **X** in VikunjaX. Recursive (CASL 0) is the single face for headings and work. The mark is `vikunjax.svg` (cadmium disc, llama with shades); the wordmark is Vikunja + cadmium X.

Pocket Workshop (Owned Blue, Quicksand, Open Sans, 8px, modal task detail) is the discarded incumbent. Do not split the difference.
keyCharacteristics: Linen ground `#f4f1ea`, cream panel `#fffcf7`, stone ink `#1c1917`
Inspector is a pane, not a modal. Hidden until a task is selected. Drawer below 1100px. Rail overlay below 720px.
Top bar is ground; inspector is panel; rail is dark; work canvas is ground.

rules.name: The Cadmium Tool Rule
rules.body: Cadmium is for actions, links, and “you are here.” Not a background wash.

rules.name: The Set-Down Rule
rules.body: Completing a task is quiet and certain. No confetti, no extra delay, no “successfully marked as.” Undo stays on the toast.

rules.name: The Earth Status Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and danger sit on the linen desk (sage, ochre, brick). Neon greens, candy oranges, and Bulma blue are anti-references.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Recursive for headings, chrome, and work. Do not bring back Quicksand or Open Sans.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Tool Rule
rules.body: Buttons are sentence case. Do not uppercase task titles, project names, or running text.

rules.name: The Blotter Rule
rules.body: Page-load tiles are placed down, once per view. Do not restagger on filter, drag, or scroll-load.

rules.name: The One-Column Board Rule
rules.body: On the phone, kanban shows one named bucket at a time. Desktop keeps the multi-column board. Never a stacked list of columns.

rules.name: The Border-Plus-Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting cards are hairline-only. Shadows appear on hover or overlay.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Rule
rules.body: 4px for controls, cards, inputs, tags. Full circles for people. No 8px+ “app rounding.”

dos: Do keep the VikunjaX wordmark (cadmium X). Cadmium is the only brand accent.
Do keep the inspector as a pane, never a modal overlay, on desktop.
Do hide subtasks as loose rows unless “Show in list” is on.
Do put the subtask chevron in a gutter left of the parent tile, not inside the card. Nested tiles share the parent’s left edge and the same `0.4rem` gap as the list.
Do use logical properties for spacing.
Do treat phone kanban as a one-column pager (named bucket, arrows + snap). Desktop stays a board.
Do expand a phone kanban card in place; do not open the inspector from that tap.
Do prefix any Tailwind utility with `tw-`.
donts: Don't bring back Owned Blue, Quicksand, Open Sans, or 8px rounding.
Don't paint large surfaces with Cadmium (The Cadmium Tool Rule).
Don't use `--white` for text on primary buttons.
Don't invert dark mode to cool 210° greys, or restore neon success / candy orange warning.
Don't uppercase task, project, or button labels.
Don't drop the 1px card border in favor of shadow-only lift.
Don't round past 4px except for avatars and spinners.
Don't restack kanban columns vertically on the phone.
